tasks.subject: Task 5: Privacy scanner (patterns + corpus) and tripwire
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A fail-closed scanner with two layers: pattern checks (live QR tokens) that run everywhere including CI, and a --corpus cross-reference that scans committed contents AND filenames for any real name/attendee-ID/surname-fragment where raw_data is present (the manual PII sweep, codified). Conftest tripwire runs both. Carries the original plan's leaky-input test rigor; the real->committed scrubber is NOT carried (fixtures are synthetic).

**Files:**
- Create: tools/check_private_data.py, tests/privacy/test_fixture_hygiene.py
- Modify: tests/conftest.py (tripwire half)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Pattern layer flags a scoutingevent.com/mobile/?t= token not starting with TESTTOKEN
- --corpus layer flags a real name/ID in contents or filename, incl. a surname fragment and a substring name (Ann Lee in Ann Leeson)
- Reports 'private-data findings: 0' on clean fixtures, never echoing the matched value
- Tripwire runs pattern always + corpus when raw_data exists; non-zero exit on findings

**Verify:** `uv run python tools/check_private_data.py --corpus raw_data tests && uv run pytest tests/privacy -q`

```json:metadata
{"files":["tools/check_private_data.py","tests/conftest.py","tests/privacy/test_fixture_hygiene.py"],"verifyCommand":"uv run python tools/check_private_data.py --corpus raw_data tests && uv run pytest tests/privacy -q","acceptanceCriteria":["flags live token","corpus flags name/id/fragment in contents+filename","substring name caught","0 findings on clean","never echoes matches"],"modelTier":"standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 12: Collision-free output filenames via per-run UUID
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Raw-payload and email filenames are distinct per attendee and carry no raw ID - readable slug + per-run UUID short form.

**Two write sites, two contexts (verified against code):** raw payloads at scout_schedule_cli.py:490+:554 are INSIDE process_scout (called only from async_main:1743) so a RunIdentity must be PASSED into process_scout; emails at :935 are inside write_email_reports which is called both from write_outputs AND independently from ui/server.py:313 (generate_emails, no RunIdentity in scope) so write_email_reports must mint its OWN local RunIdentity. Collision-freedom does not need the two UUIDs to match. Persisted/resume identity (D25 run checkpoint) is Slice 2.

**Files:**
- Modify: scout_schedule_cli.py (attendee_filename_stem after :595-597; run_identity param on process_scout used at :490 covering :554; local RunIdentity in write_email_reports at :935; construct+pass RunIdentity from async_main)
- Test: tests/unit/test_output_filenames.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- attendee_filename_stem = slug + output_id[:8] (hyphens stripped); no raw id
- Two same-named different-id attendees -> distinct RAW filenames (process_scout) AND distinct EMAIL filenames (write_email_reports)
- process_scout run_identity param defaults to None and self-creates so Task 9 calls keep working
- stable within run

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_output_filenames.py -q`

